title: PasswordReset Bug Dana-i Ver. 3.0.0.2
symptom: After a password reset, the password is empty instead of the serial number. The user exported settings with an empty password, but on import the file is reported as manipulated and cannot be imported. Reinstalling the app did not help.
cause: The bug is that in version 3.0.0.2, export with an empty password is possible, which is not allowed because the master password is used for encryption. This was fixed in version 3.1.
fix: The user is advised that export without a password is not possible because the master password is used for encryption. The bug was fixed in version 3.1, but no rescue option is provided for the existing export.
evidence_quote: Export with empty password works in 3.0.0.2. You fixed this bug in 3.1 that sounds good.
